name: test-after
description: Test-After workflow where implementation comes before tests. Implement feature first, then write comprehensive tests. Suitable for bug fixes, minor changes, and urgent patches where quick iteration is needed.

subagent.description: Quick exploration to understand bug context or feature scope. Planning optional for straightforward changes.

workflowSteps.name: Review Task
workflowSteps.description: Understand bug report, feature request, or change requirements

workflowSteps.name: Implement Fix/Feature
workflowSteps.description: Write code to fix bug or implement feature

workflowSteps.name: Manual Verification
workflowSteps.description: Test implementation manually to confirm it works

workflowSteps.name: Write Tests
workflowSteps.description: Create test suite to prevent regression

workflowSteps.name: Verify
workflowSteps.description: Run all tests, check for regressions

useCases: Bug fixes with clear reproduction steps
